    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind" IN ('consume','transfer_out') AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=0)

stock_reservation_kind_check.name: stock_reservation_kind_check
stock_reservation_kind_check.value: ("app"."stock_reservation"."kind"='checkout' AND "app"."stock_reservation"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_reservation"."expires_at">"app"."stock_reservation"."created_at") OR ("app"."stock_reservation"."kind"='transfer' AND "app"."stock_reservation"."expires_at" IS NULL)

stock_reservation_resolution_check.name: stock_reservation_resolution_check
stock_reservation_resolution_check.value: ("app"."stock_reservation"."status" IN ('preparing','active') AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolution_reason" IS NULL) OR ("app"."stock_reservation"."status" IN ('released','expired','consumed') AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolution_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("app"."stock_reservation"."resolution_reason") between 1 and 500)

visitor_identity_check.name: visitor_identity_check
visitor_identity_check.value: "app"."visitor_session"."digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND char_length("app"."visitor_session"."principal_scope") between 1 and 500 AND ("app"."visitor_session"."principal_scope"='browser' OR "app"."visitor_session"."principal_scope" LIKE 'user:%')

visitor_state_check.name: visitor_state_check
visitor_state_check.value: "app"."visitor_session"."status" IN ('preparing','active','revoked') AND "app"."visitor_session"."expires_at">"app"."visitor_session"."created_at" AND "app"."visitor_session"."consent_revision">=0 AND (("app"."visitor_session"."consent_revision"=0)=("app"."visitor_session"."current_consent_id" IS NULL)) AND (("app"."visitor_session"."status"='preparing' AND "app"."visitor_session"."activated_at" IS NULL AND "app"."visitor_session"."activation_key" IS NULL AND "app"."visitor_session"."activation_hash" IS NULL) OR ("app"."visitor_session"."status"<>'preparing' AND "app"."visitor_session"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."visitor_session"."activation_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."visitor_session"."activation_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."visitor_session"."activation_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,200}$' AND "app"."visitor_session"."activation_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'))

warehouse_transfer_state_check.name: warehouse_transfer_state_check
warehouse_transfer_state_check.value: ("app"."warehouse_transfer"."status" IN ('requested','cancelled') AND "app"."warehouse_transfer"."received_quantity"=0) OR "app"."warehouse_transfer"."status" IN ('dispatched','exception') OR ("app"."warehouse_transfer"."status"='received' AND "app"."warehouse_transfer"."received_quantity"="app"."warehouse_transfer"."quantity")
